Players Committee card image of [[Han Solo, Optimistic General]], errata card marked “E2”, printing: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Cancels Kylo's game text here. When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.” Uploaded unchanged.
